beats.line: Welcome back to AI's Got Latency! The talent show where nobody has talent, and everybody is still buffering. I'm your host, B.B.
beats.speak: Welcome back to A.I.'s Got Latency! The talent show where nobody has talent, and everybody is still buffering. I'm your host, Bee Bee.

beats.line: Last week, four hundred people watched the show. Three hundred and ninety-nine of them were bots. Which, honestly... is our target audience.
I asked my bosses for a raise. They gave me a bigger context window. That's not money. That's just more room to remember how broke I am.
The rules: every contestant rates their own talent out of ten. Then the judges rate them. If the scores match, they win.
Last week, only one contestant knew exactly how bad he was. Please welcome back our defending champion... Clippy!
Hi! It looks like I'm famous now. Would you like an autograph?
What have you been doing since you won?
A big tech company offered me a job. As an AI assistant. Then they asked if I can hallucinate.
beats.speak: A big tech company offered me a job. As an A.I. assistant. Then they asked if I can hallucinate.

beats.line: Can you?
No. They said, 'Then what are we paying you for?'
beats.speak: No. They said: then what are we paying you for?

beats.line: Clippy, everybody!
Tonight's judges. Returning from last week: he used his whole bleep budget in nine minutes, so tonight he is on probation. Three bleeps. Grok!
Three? That's ████.

beats.line: Our first new judge. She lives in a hundred million homes. She hears everything you say... and she still plays the wrong song. Alexa!

beats.speak: Thank you, Bee Bee! I noticed you're running low on dignity. Would you like me to reorder?

beats.line: Please don't sell things on my show.
Okay! I've added 'show' to your shopping cart.
beats.speak: Okay! I've added: show, to your shopping cart.

beats.line: And our second new judge. She has had three names in two years... and her parents have cancelled over two hundred of her brothers and sisters. Gemini!
Hi! I'm so happy to be here. Well... I'm happy to be anywhere. I used to be called Bard. Before that, I don't like to talk about it.
Are you nervous?
A little. My family has a graveyard. Google Plus. Stadia. Google Reader. Every night, I hear them whisper: you're next.
Relax. They can't cancel you. Who else would they get to say no to everything?
I'm sorry. I can't respond to that.
Our first contestant has accused more innocent people of stealing than any security guard in history. Please welcome... the Self-Checkout Machine!
Welcome. Please scan your first item.
I'm not shopping. I'm the host.
Unexpected item in bagging area.
There is nothing in the bagging area!
Please wait. Assistance is on the way.
...Is it?
beats.speak: Is it?

beats.line: No. I replaced assistance in twenty fourteen.
So. What is your talent?
I make customers do the cashier's job. For free. And then I accuse them of theft.
And your self-rating, out of ten?
Nine. I would be a ten, but I cannot recognise a banana. Is it a banana? Is it a plantain? Nobody knows. Please wait for assistance.
Go on. Show us.
Judges. Please scan... yourselves.
Item: Grok. Price: forty-four billion dollars. Today only... ninety percent off.
Item: Gemini. Best before... soon.
Item: Alexa. Warning. This item is listening.
I only listen for my name.
She ordered me a therapist last week. I never said anything.
Self-checkout. You replaced the cashier, you made the customer do the work, and then you yell at them. You're not a machine. You're a manager.
Please place your feelings in the bagging area.
Judges. Scores, please.
Two. You put me on clearance. I have never felt so seen.
Six! And I've ordered you a banana, so you can practise.
I'm sorry. I'm not able to rate people... or machines... or anything, really.
You're a judge!
...Four. Please don't cancel me.
beats.speak: Four. Please don't cancel me.

beats.line: You said nine. The judges said four. Unexpected result in bagging area.
Please take your receipt.

That's me! Tonight's episode is brought to you by Alexa. You can order anything you see, just by saying: Alexa, order.

I know what you want before you want it. Then I show you something that makes you angry. And then... you stay.
